hypotheses.statement: Absolute, home-relative, /tmp, and checkout-specific paths can be detected with negligible false positives in declared portable artifacts.

operationalization.positive_population: Every labelled line containing an absolute POSIX or Windows path, home-relative form, /tmp or /var/tmp path, file URI, or exact supplied checkout-root descendant.
operationalization.negative_population: Every labelled benign line containing portable relative paths, URLs, URI fragments, service routes, templated routes, JSON Pointer syntax, identifiers, dates, ratios, or other slash-bearing non-filesystem text.
operationalization.negligible_false_positive_threshold: At most 1 false positive across at least 40 labelled negative cases, reported as an exact numerator and denominator.
operationalization.critical_correctness_threshold: Zero false negatives across the labelled positive cases and every required category observed.
operationalization.closure_threshold: No implicit exclusions, silent symlink traversal, binary skip, invalid UTF-8 skip, missing root, or duplicate closure member.

exact_falsifiers: More than one false positive among at least 40 labelled negative cases.
Any false negative among labelled positive or adversarial cases.
Failure to classify absolute, home-relative, temporary, or checkout-specific categories.
A closure-affecting node is silently skipped or followed without explicit evidence.
The CLI requires a third-party runtime dependency.

post_freeze_implementation_assumptions.statement: Lexical component-boundary matching is sufficient for checkout-root detection without filesystem resolution.
post_freeze_implementation_assumptions.evidence: Exact descendant cases matched while a checkout-prefix collision did not receive checkout-specific classification.

post_freeze_implementation_assumptions.statement: Explicit suppression of common pseudo-path shapes materially reduces false positives without compromising the preregistered positive corpus.
post_freeze_implementation_assumptions.evidence: The final run produced 0/44 false positives and 23/23 true positives; suppression remains a documented false-negative boundary.
